summary: Comprehensive backend + frontend testing of Sahyadri Souls Trek website. All 13 backend pytest tests passed (100%). All major frontend flows working: homepage, treks listing with filter/search, trek detail with booking form, admin login/dashboard, about/contact pages, WhatsApp widget with auto-popup. Booking creation API integrates successfully with Razorpay checkout (mock keys).

minor.issue: Admin token returned at login is a random UUID never validated. Admin endpoints (POST/PUT/DELETE /api/treks, /api/reviews, /api/bookings, GET /api/admin/stats, GET /api/bookings) are NOT protected by any auth check on backend - anyone can call them without a token. This is a security gap, even if frontend gates them via localStorage.
Returns razorpay key_id (test_key) in the response which is fine for client-side checkout, but with mock keys real payment cannot complete (expected since Razorpay is MOCKED).

issues: Page text is very brief (~714 chars). WhatsApp number 7588917768 was not detected in body text - verify it is rendered (may be inside a tel: link or icon-only). Consider clearly displaying phone, email, address.

action_items: (Optional/Security) Add backend auth middleware to validate admin token on protected endpoints (Trek CRUD POST/PUT/DELETE, Review approve/delete, /api/bookings list, /api/admin/stats). Currently only admin/login is gated; other 'admin' endpoints are public.
(Minor) Replace deprecated @app.on_event('shutdown') with FastAPI lifespan handler.
(Minor) Replace bare 'except:' at server.py line 27 with specific exception handling.
(UX) Verify Contact page prominently displays WhatsApp number 7588917768, email, and Chhatrapati Sambhaji Nagar address.
critical_code_review_comments: SECURITY: All admin-mutating endpoints (POST/PUT/DELETE /api/treks, /api/reviews/*/approve, DELETE /api/reviews, GET /api/bookings, GET /api/admin/stats) have no auth dependency. The token returned by /api/admin/login is never verified server-side. Add a Depends(verify_admin_token) on these routes.
MongoDB ObjectId is correctly excluded via projection {'_id': 0} - good.
datetime stored as ISO string and parsed back - works but inconsistent; consider storing as native datetime.
Bare except at line 27 swallows all errors silently.
test_credentials: admin / admin123 (verified working). Test customer used: TEST_UI_Booker / ui_test@example.com / 9876543210.
seed_data_creation: Did not modify seed data. Backend tests created and cleaned up TEST_ prefixed treks. A few TEST_ bookings remain in DB (expected - no delete endpoint for bookings).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py covers Trek CRUD, Reviews, Admin login/stats, Booking create+persist. All 13 pass. Frontend visually verified: home (hero/CTA), /treks (6 treks, search, difficulty filter), /treks/:id (gallery, booking form with 5 fields, Book Now triggers POST /api/bookings/create-order=200 and opens Razorpay iframe), /admin/login (admin/admin123 works, wrong creds shows 'Invalid credentials' toast), /admin/dashboard (stats cards: Total Treks=6, Bookings=4, Revenue=₹0, Pending Reviews=0; tabs Treks/Bookings/Reviews), WhatsApp widget auto-popup after 5s with Chat with Us + Join Our Community buttons. No console/page errors detected.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A - no critical issues. Razorpay payment uses mock test_key/test_secret as documented; full payment-completion flow cannot be verified end-to-end without real keys, but order creation returns 200 and Razorpay checkout iframe loads correctly.
